questions.TEACHER_TRAINING_AND_EDUCATION_SCIENCE: How interested are you in planning teaching-learning processes, developing pedagogical strategies and helping different audiences build new skills?
questions.ARTS: How interested are you in conceiving and creating visual works (drawing, painting, sculpture) or developing design projects (graphic, multimedia, product), using techniques and materials to express ideas and solve communication problems?
questions.HUMANITIES: How interested are you in researching and critically interpreting historical sources, philosophical currents or literary texts to understand the evolution of societies and human thought?
questions.SOCIAL_AND_BEHAVIORAL_SCIENCES: How interested are you in analyzing patterns of human behavior, investigating social dynamics and applying theoretical models to understand how individuals, groups and societies work?
questions.INFORMATION_AND_JOURNALISM: How interested are you in researching, fact-checking, writing news and producing informative content for different platforms (press, radio, TV, digital), with the goal of communicating it to the public?
questions.BUSINESS_AND_MANAGEMENT: How interested are you in planning organizational strategies, managing resources (financial, human, material) and analyzing market data to optimize a company's performance and profitability?
questions.LAW: How interested are you in interpreting legislation, analyzing concrete cases and building logical arguments to represent and defend the interests of people or organizations in judicial or extrajudicial contexts?
questions.LIFE_SCIENCES: How interested are you in investigating the biological mechanisms of living beings at the molecular, cellular and ecosystem levels, carrying out laboratory experiments or fieldwork to expand scientific knowledge?
questions.PHYSICAL_SCIENCES: How interested are you in studying the fundamental principles of matter and energy (Physics) and the composition, structure and transformation of substances (Chemistry), using mathematical models and experimental methods?
questions.MATHEMATICS_AND_STATISTICS: How interested are you in developing and applying mathematical models, analyzing data sets and using statistical methods to extract patterns, make predictions and solve complex problems?
questions.COMPUTER_SCIENCE: How interested are you in designing software architectures, developing algorithms and writing code to create and maintain applications, computer systems and technological solutions?
questions.ENGINEERING_AND_RELATED_TECHNOLOGIES: How interested are you in applying scientific and mathematical principles to design, build and test systems, machines, electrical circuits or processes, in order to create functional technical solutions?
questions.MANUFACTURING_INDUSTRIES: How interested are you in planning, managing and optimizing production processes in industrial environments, controlling the quality, logistics and efficiency of production lines and supply chains?
questions.ARCHITECTURE_AND_CONSTRUCTION: How interested are you in designing spaces (buildings, interiors, urban areas), combining aesthetics, functionality and technique, and in planning and supervising the various phases of a construction project?
questions.AGRICULTURE_FORESTRY_AND_FISHERIES: How interested are you in managing agricultural, forestry or aquaculture production systems, applying knowledge of biology and technology to optimize harvests, manage natural resources and ensure sustainability?
questions.VETERINARY_SCIENCE: How interested are you in diagnosing, treating and preventing diseases in animals (pets, livestock or wildlife), as well as ensuring their well-being and the food safety of products of animal origin?
questions.HEALTH: How interested are you in providing direct care to people, making diagnoses, administering treatments, performing therapeutic techniques and monitoring patients' recovery in clinical or hospital settings?
questions.SOCIAL_SERVICES: How interested are you in assessing the social needs of individuals, families or communities and planning interventions to promote their integration, empowerment and access to resources and social rights?
questions.PERSONAL_SERVICES: How interested are you in planning and providing direct customer services in areas such as hospitality, tourism or aesthetics, focusing on organizing experiences, personalized service and guaranteeing customer satisfaction?
questions.TRANSPORT_SERVICES: How interested are you in planning, managing and optimizing logistics and transport operations for goods or passengers, coordinating routes, fleets and supply chains to ensure efficiency and meet deadlines?
questions.ENVIRONMENTAL_PROTECTION: How interested are you in monitoring ecosystems, assessing the environmental impact of human activities and developing technical solutions for waste management, pollution control and the conservation of natural resources?
questions.SECURITY_SERVICES: How interested are you in planning and carrying out surveillance operations, access control and risk prevention to protect people, property and facilities, applying security protocols and responding to emergencies?

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy:
privacyPolicy.intro: This policy explains in simple terms what data we process, why, and what your rights are.
privacyPolicy.section1Body: The controller of your data is the author of this site.
privacyPolicy.section2Title: 2. What data do we collect and why?
privacyPolicy.section2Body: If you create an account, we store the details you provide when signing up (such as your username and email) so you can log in. If you post, comment or like content, we store that activity linked to your account, and your username is publicly shown next to your posts and comments. Our server keeps basic access logs, which include your IP address, for security reasons.
privacyPolicy.section3Body: We only use strictly necessary cookies, set by our authentication service (Keycloak) to log you in, keep your session active and protect the login process. During login, your browser also temporarily stores some technical data (local storage) for the same purpose. Because they are essential for the site to work, they don't require your consent. We don't use analytics or advertising cookies.
privacyPolicy.section4Title: 4. Who do we share the data with?
privacyPolicy.section4Body: We don't sell your data or share it for commercial purposes. The site is hosted by a hosting provider (OVHcloud), which stores the data on our behalf. To display the site, your browser connects to some external services that receive your IP address: Google Fonts (font) and OpenStreetMap (institutions map).
privacyPolicy.section5Title: 5. How long do we keep the data?
privacyPolicy.section5Body: We keep your account data and the content you post for as long as your account exists. You can ask us to delete your account and your data at any time using the contact below.
privacyPolicy.section6Body: You have the right to access, correct or delete your data.
privacyPolicy.section7Body: If you have any questions about this policy or want to exercise your rights, you can contact:

termsAndConditions.title: Terms and Conditions:
termsAndConditions.intro: By using this site, you accept these terms. If you don't agree with them, you shouldn't use the site.
termsAndConditions.section1Body: The site lets you search for higher-education courses and institutions in Portugal, as well as read and share reviews about them. The service is free.
termsAndConditions.section2Body: You need an account to post, comment or like content. You are responsible for keeping your login details safe and for all activity done with your account. How we handle your personal data is described in the Privacy Policy.
termsAndConditions.section3Body: You are responsible for the content you post. You may not post content that is illegal, offensive, defamatory, discriminatory, misleading, advertising, spam, or other people's personal data. Reviews must be honest and based on your own experience.
termsAndConditions.section4Body: We may remove any content or suspend accounts that don't follow these terms, without prior notice.
termsAndConditions.section5Body: Information about courses and institutions is based on official DGES data gathered in October 2025, so it may be outdated or incomplete. Always confirm the information with the official sources before making decisions. Published reviews are the responsibility of their authors and don't reflect the position of the site.
termsAndConditions.section6Body: The site is provided as is, with no guarantee of availability or of being error-free. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any damage resulting from the use of the site or the information it shows.
termsAndConditions.section7Body: We may change these terms at any time. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page.
termsAndConditions.section8Body: If you have any questions about these terms, you can contact:
